name: maker-box-select-used
about: The top face's outline used, view normal (n); a window box round the whole outline selects the 8 used curves; a crossing box (right to left) over the front-left corner selects the arc and its two lines; Escape
source: lead 11-27: the maker flow (the user's own: a part with filleted / spline outlines, a sketch on its face, Use, Offset, chain selection, dimensions and constraints to used geometry, Extrude, Fillet of tangent chains)
